subject: Demo request: GitHub integration for OpenLib

From: Samir Patel <samir@openlib.org>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request: GitHub integration for OpenLib

Hi Jonas,

I signed up for a trial yesterday and have been poking around Redwood - nice work. Our team at OpenLib (open-source library management) is evaluating ways to integrate Redwood into our CI and GitHub workflows. A few questions before a demo:

- Does Redwood have native GitHub integration or a webhook pattern for repo events?
- Can we limit model access to selected repos or orgs?
- Any on-prem / private deployment options for sensitive metadata?

Would love to book a demo this week to see the integration story and ask some questions about rate limits and batching.

A couple of folks who should join are the maintainers: maintainers@openlib.org.

Thanks,
Samir
Maintainer, OpenLib
https://github.com/openlib/core
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 13:02:10 -0700

Hi Samir - welcome and thanks for signing up!

We do have several patterns teams use for GitHub integrations: webhook-driven event captures, a GitHub Apps flow for scoped repo access, and private deployments for sensitive data. I can walk through the options in a 30-min demo and tailor recommendations for OpenLib.

Are you available for any of the following slots?
- Mon 29 Jun, 10:00-10:30 PT
- Mon 29 Jun, 15:00-15:30 PT
- Tue 30 Jun, 09:00-09:30 PT

Or you can pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/jonas-weber/redwood-demo

I attached a short slide deck that covers our integration patterns and deployment modes - should help prep the team. Also looping in Laura Bennett (AE) and Markus Klein (Solutions Eng) who can join the demo for architecture and pricing questions.

Best,
Jonas Weber
SDR, Redwood Inference

Thanks, Jonas - Mon 29 Jun 10:00 PT works for us.

A couple of quick details to tailor the session:
- We host CI and repos on GitHub Enterprise (GHES) behind a VPC; any notes on private-hosted GitHub support?
- We need SSO (SAML) for any UI access and scoped deploy keys for the integration - is that supported?
- Example repo: https://github.com/openlib/core (feel free to look at the repo layout).

On the call we'll have a maintainer and our infra engineer. Could you confirm the attendee list and whether Laura/Markus will join?

Samir
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@openlib.org>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:10:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request: GitHub integration for OpenLib

Hi Samir - confirmed for Mon 29 Jun 10:00 PT (I booked the slot and sent a calendar invite).

Quick answers up front:
- GHES (private GitHub) is supported. We typically integrate via a GitHub App that can be deployed into your GHES environment, or via webhook proxies for air-gapped setups. Markus will demo the App flow and the proxy pattern.
- SSO/SAML is supported for our Console (we also support SCIM provisioning for larger orgs).
- Scoped deploy keys and repo-level permissions are the recommended approach; we never ask for blanket org-level tokens unless requested.

I've attached our SSO + integration one-pager for the meeting. Laura will cover pricing and rollout options; Markus will cover deployment patterns. If anything changes on your side, reply here and we can reschedule.

See you on the call - joining details: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-openlib-demo-20260629

Best,
Jonas Weber
